issues.legal_issue: An application under Order XXXIX Rule 2A of the Code of Civil Procedure is maintainable to address disobedience of an undertaking or injunction order made during the pendency of a suit.
An advocate cannot bind a client by giving an undertaking to the court without the client’s requisite authority.
Alienating property in breach of an undertaking made to the court and incorporated into an order constitutes wilful disobedience warranting contempt jurisdiction.
The punishment for contempt, including confinement in civil prison, may be modified in light of the contemnor’s age and circumstances.
